data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: By UPI Autopay, card e-mandate or eNACH, monthly or yearly. By default renewals go straight to your own Razorpay account, and Catch bills its 5% afterwards.
A member price on sessions, up to 100% off so they’re included; early booking; and sessions only members can book. You can add perks you give in person, like a free mat or a guest pass.
Yes. Members pause or cancel at the end of their period themselves. You can also pause billing for everyone, for a month off or the monsoon.
Can Catch run my whole weekly timetable?
Each class is its own session on Catch, so a busy timetable is more work than in a class-booking tool. Many studios start with workshops, socials and the classes members come to most.
Not yet. Memberships with a member price or included sessions cover most of what packs are used for.
No. Members join, book and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.
